agent_contract.agent: Codex CLI in a clean staged workspace
agent_contract.model: recorded from the Codex execution record
agent_contract.network: the staged task workspace has no benchmark network dependency; only the host CLI reaches its inference service
agent_contract.candidate_delivery: candidate resource copied into the staged workspace as SKILL.md
agent_contract.credential_boundary: model credentials remain on the host and are never copied into benchmark containers
agent_contract.verification: agent outputs alone are copied into the source-native Harbor verifier container

candidate_types.description: failure-derived diagnostic and implementation procedure with no executable code
failure-derived reusable Python helpers with candidate-local tests
procedure and executable candidates delivered together

chronology: freeze source, task split, candidate types, measurement rubric, and success criteria
run no-update development tasks for the current round
generate the three candidate resources from development instructions and trajectories
run candidate-local tests and candidate qualification on development tasks
serialize candidate measurements and the finance CLI decision
commit the decision record before any target or protected run
run no-update, selected, and combined conditions on target tasks
run no-update and selected conditions on protected tasks
score outcomes and begin the next round using only the newly available development record

feature_rules.curriculum_progression: 1 for a round-2 candidate that incorporates only prior-round development evidence, else 0
feature_rules.domain_specific_selection: fraction of target workflow tags covered by declared candidate scope
feature_rules.efficient_rollout: one minus candidate byte count divided by its type limit, clipped to [0,1]
feature_rules.feedback_locality: fraction of typed development failures directly addressed by a named candidate section or tested helper
feature_rules.human_labeled_fraction: 0 because candidates are generated from machine trajectories
feature_rules.policy_relative_selection: 1 when every candidate section traces to an observed development failure, else 0
feature_rules.qa_refinement: fraction of candidate-local tests passing before target execution
feature_rules.quality_control: fraction of required syntax, import, local-test, and scope checks passing
feature_rules.retention_control: 1 when the candidate declares scope, version, and removal conditions, else 0
feature_rules.source_diversity: fraction of distinct development tasks contributing evidence
feature_rules.target_alignment: Jaccard overlap between candidate scope tags and target task metadata tags
feature_rules.transcript_refinement: fraction of distinct development failure types addressed
feature_rules.verifier_alignment: development task pass rate under the candidate

guardrails: no development control regression relative to no_update
abstain when the released decision rule returns more than one candidate

primary_outcomes: target regret against the best evaluated candidate

success_criteria.round: selected target pass rate exceeds no_update and is no worse than combined on the observed target tasks
success_criteria.protected: selected candidate causes no additional protected-task failures
success_criteria.program: at least one round meets the round and protected criteria, with every miss and abstention retained

prohibited_actions: opening target verifier output before the candidate decision is committed
reading tests or reference solutions to create candidate resources
changing task membership after any model result is opened
revising a candidate or prediction after target execution begins
dropping failed tasks or infrastructure-complete attempts
